summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K reporting a press release announcing that Yale University's IRB approved initiation of patient recruitment for Parts B and C of its Phase I/II trial for CMND-100, an investigational drug for alcohol use disorder. The release highlights positive safety results from Part A, with 24 participants completing treatment without serious adverse events. No financial terms, transactions, or strategic actions are involved; this is a routine operational update on clinical trial progress, not a special situation.
